title: Bethesda Login Window
content: The Bethesda Login Window allows the Creation Kit to connect with Bethesda's online service, Bethesda.net. This is required for Sharing Mods with users on Xbox and Playstation. The window can be found under the title bar menu, File -> Login to Bethesda.net... Editor Window: File:Editor Bethesda Login Window.png - Save: Saves the account credentials for a later session. - Username: The Bethesda.net account name. - Password: The Bethesda.net account password. - Create Account: The button text directs the user to a URL, https://account.bethesda.net/en/join. - Login: Validates the account credentials and connects on success. - Cancel: Closes the account login window. See Also: - Creation Kit - Sharing Mods - Editor Interface
